text: Debugging is an important skill for every programmer. When your code does not work as expected, the first step is identifying bugs. You need to find where the problem starts and what causes it. Fortunately, many debugging tools can help you. For example, a debugger lets you pause your program and check the values of variables. However, tools alone are not enough. You also need a systematic approach. This means testing one part at a time and making small changes. Logging is another useful method. By adding print statements or log messages, you can see what your program is doing step by step.
